subject: Redwood Inference: vendor onboarding packet + PO prerequisites
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: ClearStream Payables <payables@clearstream.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Sep 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood Inference: vendor onboarding packet + PO prerequisites

Hi ClearStream team —

Quick intro: I’m Jonas on the partnerships team at Redwood Inference. We’re starting a PO-based relationship for Q4 work and I’m sending our AP onboarding packet so you can register Redwood as a vendor in your system. Attached: Redwood_AP_Packet_v1.pdf and W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf.

A few things we need confirmed on your side so invoices flow correctly into your payment runs:
- Mandatory PO fields: PO Number must appear on every invoice header (no PO-less invoices).
- Bill-to name: Redwood Inference, Inc. (legal entity).
- Remit-to: we’ll provide bank details; please tell us whether you prefer direct bank details or a secure portal upload.
- Invoice format: PDF is fine; if you prefer UBL/CSV please share the schema.
- Payment terms: our standard is Net30; we are open to early-pay discount discussions (1.5%/10).

Please confirm the following back to me so I can finish the portal registration: your vendor code (if you pre-assign), the vendor portal URL for registration, and any additional fields your AP team requires (tax form type, EORI/VAT for EU entities, remit email for payment notifications).

Thanks — I’ve cc’d Lauren (finance ops) to help with tax/bank follow-up.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachments: Redwood_AP_Packet_v1.pdf (AP onboarding packet), W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf (tax form)

From: ClearStream Payables <payables@clearstream.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Alyssa Chen <alyssa.chen@clearstream.com>
Date: Fri, 15 Sep 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference: vendor onboarding packet + PO prerequisites

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the packet. A few notes from AP so we can proceed:

1) Required vendor fields to create your record:
   - Legal name (as it appears on tax registry)
   - Tax ID / VAT (TIN for US entities)
   - Remit-to bank last 4 digits + currency
   - Preferred remit notification email (for remittance advices)

2) Invoice/PO rules:
   - PO Number is mandatory on every invoice and will be used for 3-way match; invoices without a PO will be held.
   - Please include our GL/Cost center on the invoice line if provided on PO.
   - Attach a PDF invoice; we accept UBL as an optional electronic format via our SFTP endpoint.

3) Portal: please register here to upload supporting docs and to retrieve your vendor code:
   https://procurement.clearstream.com/vendor-portal/registration/ABCD-1234

4) Next steps: fill the portal form and upload your W-9 and a sample invoice showing the PO field. Once created, we’ll send a vendor code and a test PO number for validation.

If you can provide the bank last 4 and a sample invoice PDF, I’ll route this to vendor setup and mark the record for expedited onboarding.

Regards,
ClearStream Payables Team
payables@clearstream.com

--
Alyssa Chen
Manager, Supplier Onboarding
ClearStream Logistics
alyssa.chen@clearstream.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood Inference: vendor onboarding packet + PO prerequisites

Jonas — forwarding ClearStream’s request. Vivek / Finance Ops — can you pull together the quick items below so we can complete their portal?

Required from finance ops:
- Legal entity exact name (confirmation for portal)
- Tax ID / VAT number (W-9 attached already but we should confirm portal field)
- Remit-to bank details (we will provide last 4 for the portal; full details go via secure upload)
- Sample invoice PDF with PO field populated (use the test PO they’ll send or the sample PO we include)

Also, Marissa — please add a bullet in the implementation kickoff docs for the TO-BE flow: ensure engineering adds PO header validation to our billing process so we never issue invoices without a PO number for ClearStream.

If Finance can drop the sample invoice and the bank last-4 to this thread by EOD today, I’ll submit the portal form and request expedited vendor code assignment.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Head of Finance Ops (interim)
Redwood Inference

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: ClearStream Payables <payables@clearstream.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Sep 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood Inference: vendor onboarding packet + PO prerequisites

Hi Alyssa / ClearStream team —

Thanks for the clear instructions. Per your request, please find the initial details below and the attached sample invoice for format validation: Redwood_SampleInvoice_20280914.pdf (PDF shows PO field populated). Also attached: Redwood_Bank_Remittance_Last4.txt (contains bank last 4 = 6721).

Redwood details for portal: 
- Legal name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Tax ID (TIN): 12-3456789
- VAT / EORI: N/A (US-only entity)
- Preferred remit email: remittance@redwoodinference.com
- Currency: USD

Sample invoice notes:
- Invoice references: PO: PO-CL-2028-0914-01
- Line-level GL not required unless provided on PO; we will include if present.

We will register via your vendor portal link as well but wanted to share these items directly to avoid delays. Please confirm when a vendor code has been created and, if possible, send a short test PO we can invoice against to validate the routing.

Best regards,
Vivek Kulkarni
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Redwood_SampleInvoice_20280914.pdf, Redwood_Bank_Remittance_Last4.txt
